# Ezekiel 13 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** The LORD's message came to me:

**2** "Son of man, prophesy against the prophets of Israel who are making up their own prophecies. Tell them to listen to the word of the LORD!

**3** The Lord GOD says: How terrible it will be for these foolish prophets who follow their own imagination and have never actually seen anything from Me!

**4** Israel, your prophets are like jackals scavenging in the ruins.

**5** They haven't stepped into the gaps in the wall. They haven't done anything to repair the defenses so Israel could stand strong in the day of the LORD's battle.

**6** Their visions are fake, and their predictions are lies. They say, 'The LORD declares,' but the LORD never sent them. And yet they actually expect their words to come true!

**7** Haven't your visions been false? Haven't your predictions been lies? You keep saying, 'The LORD declares,' but I never said a word to you."

**8** So the Lord GOD says: "Because you've spoken lies and seen false visions, I am against you, declares the Lord GOD.

**9** I will raise My hand against the prophets who see fake visions and tell lies. They will be excluded from the community of My people. Their names won't appear in Israel's registry. They'll never set foot in the land of Israel again. Then you'll know that I am the Lord GOD.

**10** They have misled My people by saying, 'Everything is fine!' — when nothing is fine. When people build a flimsy wall, these prophets come along and slap some whitewash on it.

**11** That whitewashed wall is going to collapse! I'll send driving rain, hailstones, and hurricane winds to tear it apart, declares the Lord GOD.

**12** That whitewashed wall is going to collapse! I'll send driving rain, hailstones, and hurricane winds to tear it apart, declares the Lord GOD.

**13** That whitewashed wall is going to collapse! I'll send driving rain, hailstones, and hurricane winds to tear it apart, declares the Lord GOD.

**14** That whitewashed wall is going to collapse! I'll send driving rain, hailstones, and hurricane winds to tear it apart, declares the Lord GOD.

**15** That whitewashed wall is going to collapse! I'll send driving rain, hailstones, and hurricane winds to tear it apart, declares the Lord GOD.

**16** That whitewashed wall is going to collapse! I'll send driving rain, hailstones, and hurricane winds to tear it apart, declares the Lord GOD.

**17** "Now, son of man, turn your attention to the women among your people who make up their own prophecies. Prophesy against them.

**18** Say to them: The Lord GOD says: How terrible it will be for women who sew magic charms on people's wrists and make veils of various sizes to trap souls! Do you think you can hunt down the souls of My people and save your own?

**19** You have dishonored Me among My people for a few handfuls of barley and scraps of bread. You condemn people who should live and protect people who should die — all by lying to My people, who love hearing lies."

**20** So the Lord GOD says: I will rip those magic charms off and set My people free from your clutches. They won't be your prey anymore. Then you'll know that I am the LORD.

**21** So the Lord GOD says: I will rip those magic charms off and set My people free from your clutches. They won't be your prey anymore. Then you'll know that I am the LORD.

**22** So the Lord GOD says: I will rip those magic charms off and set My people free from your clutches. They won't be your prey anymore. Then you'll know that I am the LORD.

**23** So the Lord GOD says: I will rip those magic charms off and set My people free from your clutches. They won't be your prey anymore. Then you'll know that I am the LORD.

---
## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

- **13:4-5**: False prophets are like scavengers picking through rubble instead of builders repairing walls. They profit from the disaster instead of preventing it. That's a timeless critique.

- **13:10**: "Everything is fine!" when nothing is fine — that's the heart of false prophecy. Slapping whitewash on a crumbling wall. Making something rotten look respectable. God sees through the paint job.

- **13:18-19**: These women are running a spiritual racket — selling magic charms and fortune-telling for a few handfuls of grain. They're playing with people's lives for pocket change. God takes that personally.

— PNEUMA
